headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2026, back when Darby Allin vs. Brody King clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.48 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Allin escaped a barrage of Brody King offense ? including a powerbomb on the exposed floor ? countering with a drop toe hold into a steel chair before finishing with the Coffin Drop for his second successful defense.
On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Lance Archer vs. Dustin Rhodes met in a Tournament Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 6.83.

On this day in 2022, the ROH World TV Title was up for grabs as Samoa Joe vs. Trent Beretta went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.51. Trent Beretta was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
